summary: Iteration 4 testing complete. All 90 backend tests passed (69 existing + 21 new auth/PDF tests). Frontend UI testing verified: Settings page Edit Password card with lock status badges, Change Password form with error handling (wrong current, mismatched confirm), Lock Now button, navbar lock indicator (green Unlocked / yellow Locked), Offers page PDF buttons linking to /api/offers/{id}/pdf, axios interceptor correctly allowing GET requests without password prompt.
critical_code_review_comments: Auth endpoints correctly implemented: GET /api/auth/status returns {password_set: bool}
POST /api/auth/set-password validates min 4 chars, requires current_password when already set
POST /api/auth/verify returns 401 for wrong password, {ok: true, password_set: false} when no password set
bcrypt hashing working correctly (_hash_password and _verify_password functions)
GET /api/offers/{id}/pdf returns valid PDF with %PDF magic bytes and Content-Disposition attachment header
Frontend AuthProvider correctly manages passwordSet/unlocked state with sessionStorage persistence
Axios interceptor correctly gates POST/PUT/DELETE requests (except /auth/* paths) when locked
GET requests never prompt for password (correct behavior)
Settings page Edit Password card shows correct status badges (Not Set / Unlocked / Locked)
Change Password form validates: wrong current password (red error), mismatched confirm (red error), success (green message)
Lock Now button correctly locks app and updates navbar indicator
Offers page PDF buttons correctly link to /api/offers/{id}/pdf endpoint
PDF filename includes offer_code and effective_type
test_credentials: Password set during testing: test1234 (stored as bcrypt hash in db.auth_config with _id='auth_config')
seed_data_creation: No new seed data. Auth config created during testing with password 'test1234'.
